label: miR-874 mimic
caveats: MCF7 cells, 36 h. One culture per group, split into three pseudo-replicates. Treated and control are separate libraries. miR-874 drives apoptosis by 36 h, so dying cells may be included.

label: miR-365 mimic
caveats: Heart muscle cells, 48 h. No neutral control: the comparison combines raising and lowering the same miRNA. One library per group, split into three pseudo-replicates.

label: miR-98 mimic
caveats: H9 stem cells. Two paired time points, days 2 and 3, with the day as batch. Independent cultures are not established. The early window was chosen after later days lost the seed effect. miR-98 belongs to the let-7 family.

label: miR-18a knockout
caveats: A375 cells. One knockout clone. Libraries were merged, so three pseudo-replicates.

label: miR-449a and miR-340-5p
caveats: RD18 single nuclei, 60 h. Two miRNAs delivered together, no control mimic, three pseudo-replicates.

label: let-7i and miR-452
caveats: Heart muscle cells. Two miRNAs raised together, few cells, three pseudo-replicates.
